dict.string: Meety transcribes your meeting's audio on this device. The recording never leaves the device.
Meety captures the audio from your meeting apps on this device so it can be transcribed locally. The recording never leaves the device.
Meety captures the audio from your meeting's video conferencing app on this device. Only audio is read; the screen contents are not stored.
Meety reads your calendar to suggest the people you meet with and to detect when meetings start. Calendar data stays on your device.
Meety reads your calendar to suggest the people you meet with and to detect when meetings start. Calendar data stays on your device.
Meety reads your contacts so it can suggest who to invite to your workspace. Contacts stay on your device.
Meety writes meeting action items to a Reminders list you choose. Reminders stay in your iCloud account, not on Meety's servers.

Meety does not use your location.
